description: Check whether given domains are in the corpus. A hit returns a revealed card (project id, domain, short description, site type, quality index, scale and growth bands, main country, niche and, when known, the payment service), the project's other domains (regional versions, mirrors) and the profile parts available for the project. This is the only tool that accepts a raw domain; a scheme, a path, a leading www and a trailing dot are stripped, other subdomains are kept and usually miss. A domain known as another address of a project in the corpus (a regional version, a mirror or a redirect) returns that project, with mirror_of naming its domain. Every distinct submitted domain is charged the base price, including those not found unless charges_empty of lookup_domain in capabilities is false; a miss returns found: false and nothing else. A hit reveals the project to your organization for as many days as reveal_ttl_days in capabilities at no reveal price, exactly as reveal_project would, and spends one unit of coverage if your organization has not seen the project this period; reveal_project adds nothing for a project found here.

domains.description: Domains to look up; repeats count once; every distinct one found is charged, and one not found as well while charges_empty of lookup_domain in capabilities is true; the list is refused above batch.lookup_domain in capabilities; required unless quote_token is given

items.description: Domain such as example.com; a scheme, a path, a leading www and a trailing dot are stripped, other subdomains are kept

estimate.description: When true, run the query but return only its composition, price and a quote_token instead of data

quote_token.description: Execute a previous estimate: pass the quote_token instead of the query parameters

name: lookup_domain
title: Look up domains
